pin: Exact checked-in source bytes are SHA-256 pinned; main URLs identify origin, not an immutable upstream commit. Generation is offline and rejects changed bytes.
themeMerge: Brand partial overrides are merged onto Neutral for each appearance. Registry values take precedence over documentation examples.
nativeExtensions: DestructiveForeground uses Neutral light 0.985 / dark 0.205, FontSize is 14 DIPs, Spacing is 4 DIPs. Radius rem values use 16 DIPs/rem.
